description: Haircut Sharpe ratio for multiple testing (Harvey and Liu, 2015): the Sharpe a single test would have needed once the number of tests is counted, by Bonferroni and for independent tests, and with the other tests' Sharpe ratios by Holm and BHY. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

autocorrelation.description: First-order autocorrelation of the returns, -1 to 1; default 0. Corrects the annualized Sharpe as Lo (2002).

observations.description: Number of return observations behind the Sharpe ratio.

other_sharpe_ratios_annualized.description: Annualized Sharpe ratios of the other tests, over the same observations; adds the Holm and BHY haircuts.

periods_per_year.description: Observations per year: 252 daily, 365 daily crypto, 52 weekly, 12 monthly.

tests.description: Total tests run, this one included; gives the Bonferroni and independent-test haircuts.

name: validate_haircut_sharpe
title: Haircut Sharpe ratio
